cohort: The study included 2849 mother-infant pairs in the Shanghai Birth Cohort, focusing on singleton live births.
finding: No significant associations were observed between maternal plasma PFAS concentrations in early pregnancy and gestational length, overall preterm birth (PTB), spontaneous or indicated PTB.
gest_age: Preterm birth defined as <37 completed weeks' gestation; maternal plasma measured at median 15 (interquartile range: 13-16) weeks' gestation.
